passages.title: Possession and delay
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: Where a promoter fails to hand over possession by the agreed date, the promoter is liable to pay compensation for every month of delay until possession is actually handed over.

passages.title: Compensation for delay
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: Delay in completion of a project entitles the allottee to interest on the amount paid, at the rate prescribed, for the period of delay.

passages.title: Maintenance charges
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: A member must pay maintenance charges to the society every month. Non payment of maintenance charges is a breach and attracts interest on arrears.

passages.title: Power of attorney
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: A society may execute a power of attorney in favour of the developer to enable the developer to obtain permissions, approvals and no objection certificates for redevelopment.

passages.title: Stamp duty
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: Stamp duty is payable on the instrument of transfer at the rate prescribed by the stamp schedule. Registration charges are payable in addition to stamp duty.

passages.title: Registration of agreements
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: An agreement for sale must be registered under the registration law within the prescribed period, failing which it is not admissible as evidence.

passages.title: Maintenance arrears
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: Arrears of maintenance charges may be recovered by the society from the defaulting member with interest, and may be a charge on the flat.

passages.title: Arbitration
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: Any dispute arising between the parties out of this agreement shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator appointed jointly by the parties.

passages.title: Jurisdiction
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: The courts at the place where the property is situated shall have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes relating to the property.

passages.title: Force majeure
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: A party is not liable for delay caused by force majeure, being events beyond the reasonable control of that party, including natural calamities and government orders.

passages.title: Transfer of flat
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: A member may transfer a flat only after informing the society and paying the transfer fee. The society must record the transfer in its register of members.

passages.title: Nomination and succession
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: On the death of a member, the nominee or legal heir may apply to the society for transfer of the flat and membership in accordance with the bye laws.

passages.title: Redevelopment consent
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: Redevelopment of a society property requires the consent of the requisite majority of members in a general body meeting and a registered development agreement.

passages.title: Corpus fund
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: The developer shall pay a corpus amount to the society for the benefit of the members as agreed in the development agreement.

passages.title: Rent for alternative accommodation
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: The developer shall pay monthly rent for temporary alternative accommodation to each displaced member until possession of the new premises is handed over.

passages.title: Security deposit
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: The developer may be required to furnish a security deposit or bank guarantee to secure performance of the obligations under the development agreement.

passages.title: Title and indemnity
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: The society shall indemnify the developer against claims to title, and the developer shall indemnify the society against defects in construction.

passages.title: Notices
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: A notice under this agreement must be in writing and sent to the registered address of the party by hand, registered post or email acknowledged by the recipient.

passages.title: Termination
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: A party may terminate this agreement on material breach after giving written notice and a reasonable opportunity to remedy the breach.

passages.title: Occupation certificate
passages.text: PLACEHOLDER: The developer shall obtain the occupation certificate or completion certificate before handing over possession of the new building to the society.
